name: Stockholm Archipelago in a day
description_md:
The Stockholm Archipelago in a day is a one day city sightseeing walk located in Sweden. This route covers 12.2 km of walking between stops.

The full day takes about 6.8 hours to complete including visit time at each stop. This itinerary includes 6 sightseeing stops. The day is anchored in the Stockholm Archipelago.
